name: My Ange
source:
Fired from your job due to unjustified reason, you decided to move to a remote place to start anew, however everything feels off; the new apartment, the neighbourhood, and most definitely, the strange man next door.

[From [url=https://mirsketch00.itch.io/my-ange]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于无故被解雇，你决定搬到一个偏僻的地方重新开始，但一切都感觉不太好；新公寓、街区，当然还有隔壁的陌生人。

[来自[url=https://mirsketch00.itch.io/my-ange]itch.io[/url]]
